lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: Alpha wing, this is the {civilian}. Glad to have you. We're bound for NAV BETA, through the rocks.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha leader, Control. Raiders have hit two ships on this crossing this month. Not this one.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Stay with the {civilian} all the way to NAV BETA. If she runs, let her run, then bring her back on course.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Copy, Control. Alpha 2 on your wing, leader.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The flight is yours, Alpha leader. Good hunting.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Jump point opening near the {civilian}. Three raiders.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: They're on us! Alpha, we're breaking off. Get them off our back!

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Second signature, inside the belt. Four more. Watch the rocks, Alpha.

lines.speaker: raider_lead
lines.text: Nice cargo, {civilian}. Cut your engines and nobody has to bleed.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Tally four, low in the rocks. Engaging.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha, big jump signature past the belt. Six raiders. That's their whole pack.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: NAV BETA in sight. Just keep them off us a little longer.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The {civilian} is at NAV BETA and the scope is clean. Well flown, Alpha wing.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: From all of us on the {civilian}: thank you. Drinks are on us next time.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: We've lost the {civilian}. Alpha wing, come home.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Leader's down! Control, Alpha leader is down!
